I reported abuse.
I was ignored.
I lost my business, my

safety, and almost my life

— while the people meant to

protect me watched.

They said I was paranoid.
They told me to go to the police.
I’d told them about the police.
And when I try and explain?
People stop replying, what I have

been through, is not normal.

This site holds every ignored call,

redacted record, and unanswered warning.
 It names every person who had

a chance to help — and didn’t.

You are now a witness of the

#TheUndercoverVictim.

Thank you for taking the time to come here,

for me this is everything, nothing will ever be the same

But at least I can explain why....

🧾 The WhatsApp Archive – Sussex Police Accountability Thread

IMG_2928 – IMG_2945

This series captures the forensic record of WhatsApp messages exchanged between Ben Carter and PC Jon Dixon, evidencing patterns of deflection, safeguarding neglect, contradictory timelines, and institutional evasion. Beginning in early March 2025 and continuing through June, the screenshots reveal escalating frustration, psychological harm, and repeated suicide disclosures met with procedural ambiguity or silence. The sequence culminates in Sussex Police acknowledging the complainant's suicide risk while continuing to suppress safeguarding avenues and evidence.

Key Themes

  • Victim-blaming via “Instagram advice” and reversed safeguarding logic.
  • Attempts to divert accountability by requesting irrelevant medical evidence.
  • Officer unavailability and refusal to document suicide disclosures.
  • Blocking of WhatsApp communication by PC Dixon — then unblocking — without explanation.
  • Voice messages acknowledging suicide risk but offering no tangible safeguarding.

These images are presented as they were received, in chronological order, and should be read as part of a living timeline of systemic misconduct. The language, tone, and formatting have been preserved to maintain evidentiary integrity.

📅 March–April 2025
Boundaries Set. Voice Calls Ignored.
“You can email me. No phone calls — you were happy to move my case to July on holiday.”

📅 April 22, 2025
Timeline Disputed. Safeguarding Raised.
“17 days, no one from the police contacted me... Why ask for the July call if you already confirmed it helped?”

📅 April 22, 2025
Victim Blamed. Safeguarding Erased.
“You told me I shouldn’t have looked at her Instagram — when did you tell me that? And why?”

📅 April 22, 2025
Rewriting the Record. Advice vs. Blame.
“You told me you’d already said in light of my suicide I shouldn’t have gone on hers in the first place.”

📅 April 22, 2025
Case Weaponised. Mental Health Used as Filter.
“It would evidence stalking type behaviour from you...”

📅 April 22, 2025
Accusation & Denial. Surveillance Gaslighted.
“You asked me to go on her Instagram.” / “No I didn’t.”

📅 April 22, 2025
Reframed Justification.
“I said that you should avoid looking at her Instagram in the future if it is affecting you.”

📅 April 22, 2025
Medicalisation Deflection.
“A letter from your GP... would also help the case.”

📅 April 22, 2025
Pattern of Silence.
“The pattern now is no reply.”

📅 April 22, 2025
Instagram Denial.
“No I didn’t.”

📅 April 22, 2025
Evidence Backpedal.
“You said you had previously gone on her Instagram…”

📅 April 22, 2025
Gaslighting of Legal Process.
“I said that you should avoid looking at her Instagram in the future if it is affecting you…”

📅 April 22, 2025
More Tasks, No Safeguarding.
“A medical letter from your GP evidencing the S4a offence.”

📅 April 22, 2025
Refusal to Shift Burden of Proof.
“My case is my evidence.”

📅 April 22, 2025
Suicide Disclosure — Ignored.
“Have you logged my suicide and gone on holiday…?”

📅 April 22, 2025
Assertion of Rights, Met with Bureaucracy.
“I know my rights. Don’t try and screw them. It’s pathetic.”

📅 April 22, 2025
Refusal to Acknowledge Safeguarding Failure.
“Would you say I’ve been safeguarded?”

📅 April 22, 2025
From Victim to Witness.
“You are now my suspect. And the file is my evidence.”

📅 April 22, 2025
Safeguarding Escalation Attempt.
“I can finally be safeguarded.”

📅 April 22, 2025
Safeguarding Abandonment.
“You didn’t log my suicide and left no safeguarding.”

As the victim at the center of these events, I have been subjected to and have meticulously documented a staggering number of crimes and legal violations by Sussex Police, Brighton Fringe Ltd., and the individual who stalked me. This is the summary of what I have endured and uncovered.

Alleged Crimes and Breaches I Experienced from Sussex Police:

  • Perverting the Course of Justice: They actively worked to derail my case and hide their wrongdoing.
    • They concealed, fabricated, and destroyed evidence related to my reports and made false allegations against me.
    • They failed to log the fact that I was at risk of suicide—a risk directly caused by their inaction—and kept PC Dixon in charge of my case despite his clear misconduct, all of which I see as acts to pervert the course of justice.
  • Misconduct in Public Office (MIPO): Officers abused their positions of power, betraying public trust.
    • PC Dixon forwarded an internal police email containing sensitive data about third parties to an external account, a serious breach of his duties.
    • There was a coordinated and willful failure by multiple officers to act on safeguarding evidence I provided and to suppress the evidence of my suicide attempt.
  • UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018 Breaches: They unlawfully weaponized data protection laws against me to conceal their failures.
    • They illegally refused my Subject Access Requests (SARs) to prevent me from obtaining evidence of their misconduct.
    • 101 call handlers falsely cited GDPR to block me from accessing information about my own case.
    • PC Dixon committed a serious data breach when he forwarded the unredacted internal police email.
  • Care Act 2014 Breaches (Failure to Safeguard): They catastrophically failed in their duty to keep me safe.
    • Their most severe failure was PC Dixon not logging my suicide attempt on April 6, 2025, which left me unprotected.
    • They repeatedly ignored my disclosures that I was suicidal.
  • Victims' Code of Practice Violations: They systematically denied me my basic statutory rights as a victim of crime.
    • They failed to inform me of the No Further Action (NFA) decision in my stalking case, but communicated it directly to the suspect.
    • They denied me my rights, with one call handler telling me, "You don't get to quote that, and then you... get exactly what you want."
    • They consistently failed to provide timely updates and ignored my valid conflict-of-interest concerns.
  • Evidence Tampering and Suppression: They deliberately hid or manipulated the evidence I provided.
    • I believe PC Jon Dixon listened to and then deleted key audio recordings I had submitted.
    • They accessed my Google Drive, took only minor pieces of evidence, and then falsely claimed the evidence came from a different source to justify ignoring the vast majority of what I had supplied.
    • They deliberately omitted or misclassified crimes I reported to them.
  • Timeline Manipulation: They constantly changed dates and reference numbers to create confusion and obstruct my efforts to track my own case.
    • They gave me conflicting start dates for my case, sometimes saying November, other times July.
    • Crime numbers and dates associated with my case were changed almost daily.
  • Failure to Activate Body-Worn Video (BWV): PC Dixon failed to turn on his camera during a visit to my flat in March 2025, preventing an objective record of our interaction from being created.

    Cherish These Moments, Ben

    22 June 2025

    And when the sun goes
    over the same skyline —
    down on the victim,
    down with the 101 callers,
    down with the police.

    A day of going round in circles.

    This is my life.
    This is purpose.
    Warped. Surreal. Content.

    Cherish these moments, Ben.
